blocks.text: Beijing, China—Chinese President Xi Jinping said Tuesday that African mineral resources “belong to Africa”, offering Beijing’s support for the industry and warning against “geopolitical rivalries” that could harm it. China, through state-owned and private businesses, is a key player in Africa’s valuable mining sector, particularly in extraction. It is one of several major powers vying for […]...
